identity_contract.production_identity_requirement: Django live indexing must use the DB primary key or UUID as the production item identity.
identity_contract.stability_note: Notebook item_id values can change if content fields change, so they must not be treated as live production IDs.

backend_serving_note: Use the exported bundle only to transform listings into dense vectors. pgvector should perform nearest-neighbor retrieval over live DB listing vectors. The notebook artifacts are not the direct recommendation-serving engine that returns final listing IDs.
notes: The notebook is not the production serving engine.
The production-facing export is the transform bundle for generating dense vectors.
Django should use DB PK or UUID as live item identity, not notebook item_id values.
